# Use a message queue for ingestion hand-off

## Context and Problem Statement

Fetching, parsing and indexing ran in one process, so a slow indexer stalled the
fetcher and a crash lost everything in flight.

## Considered Options

- Keep the in-process pipeline and add worker goroutines
- Hand work off through a durable message queue
- Write batches to disk and poll the directory

## Decision Outcome

Chosen option: a durable message queue between the fetcher and every downstream
consumer. Each stage acknowledges only after its own write is durable.

## Consequences

Stages scale and fail independently. The queue becomes an operational dependency
that has to be monitored on its own.
